card.name: ICE score in neurotoxicity grading
card.fires_on: The abbreviation ICE (Immune Effector Cell-Associated Encephalopathy) in ICANS grading tables for bispecific antibody labels, mostly right after 'Grade 3' or 'Grade 4' or 'perform'.

modes.label: ICE after grade
modes.description: ICE appears right after a grade number, before the word score.

modes.label: ICE as an assessment
modes.description: ICE is the name of the test the patient can or cannot perform.
